data.description:
Goal:
Provide a resumable, lossless bridge and cutover state machine for repositories moving from legacy replication to protected v2 generations.

Verification:
1. Run released v0.17.6 and current binaries concurrently through bridge, freeze, final drain, activation, offline-return, and rollback fixtures.
2. Prove freeze-before-final-head ordering, full state and edge equivalence, zero accepted backlog, and monotonic recovery.
3. Run make sanity.

Constraints:
Legacy stays authoritative until remote update and recreation denial is installed and rejection-probed. Enable the malformed legacy-path v2 tripwire as defense-in-depth. Retain every legacy and generation archive indefinitely.
